Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: Misread/mis-extracted the birthplace from the GOV.UK page, claiming “Born 17 January 1863, Llanystumdwy, Caernarvonshire,” which is incorrect. David Lloyd George (Gwilym’s father) was born in Manchester (specifically Chorlton-on-Medlock). This confusion likely mixed his place of upbringing/death with birthplace and contradicted other reputable sources (e.g., Britannica), leading toward the wrong solution.
